title: DAAD-Short-term scholarships for master's degree students
summary: Short-term DAAD scholarships for Chinese master's students to conduct research for their Master's thesis at a German university or non-university research institute.

degree_levels.notes: Enrolment in a full-time Master degree course. Before the scholarship starts, applicants must have completed the second semester of their Master degree course.

subject_areas.notes: Chinese graduates from all disciplines are eligible to apply.

institutions.notes: A state or state-recognised German university or non-university research institute.

nationality.notes: Chinese graduates are eligible. Applicants must be able to prove they have completed a Bachelor degree at a Chinese university (xueshi).

residence.notes: Applicants who are already in Germany cannot be considered.

mandatory.text: Enrolment in a full-time Master degree course and completed the second semester before the scholarship starts
Completed a Bachelor degree at a Chinese university (xueshi) (should not have graduated any longer than six years before the time of application)
Recommendation letter from a Chinese professor and written confirmation of academic supervision in Germany with explicit reference to the planned undertaking
Work and study plan coordinated with an academic advisor at the chosen host institute
Sufficient proficiency in German or English proven by TestDaF, DSH II, IELTS (5.5), TOEFL iBT (80), or TEM (8) certificates

exceptions.text: Applicants who are already in Germany cannot be considered.

Students who have spent a mandatory period in Germany as part of their Master degree programme (e.g. double degree programmes) or who take part in an exchange programme at a German partner university for a year are not eligible.

funding.description: Monthly scholarship payments of 992 euros, currently valid travel allowance, and medical, accident and personal liability insurance.

application_rounds.notes: Source timezone label: CET. Unnormalised source clock time: 24.00.

required_documents.text: Extensive and detailed description of the study or research proposal and a description of previous study or research work
A precise schedule coordinated with the host institute
Officially certified copies of all university certificates for all annual examinations (with all individual grades) and explanation of grading systems
One recent, supporting letter of recommendation from a relevant professor

steps.text: 2. Request recommendation form and send it to your university teacher to complete
3. Prepare application documents, translate if necessary, and scan in PDF format
4. Fill out the application form and upload documents to the DAAD portal

sources.title: DAAD-Short-term scholarships for master's degree students - DAAD - Deutscher Akademischer Austauschdienst
sources.notes: The scholarship funds physical research visits in Germany for international (Chinese) master's degree students.
